Select compounds with exact IC50 values in nM that are potent against CHEMBL203 (IC50 < 50 nM) and weak against CHEMBL1824 (IC50 > 200 nM). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target ChEMBL IDs. Join to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain compound identifiers and canonical SMILES. Return distinct rows with columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
